description_en: Queries performance data for a node in a PolarDB cluster
description_zh: 查询PolarDB集群节点的性能数据
kebab_example: aliyun polardb describe-db-node-performance --db-node-id pi-0000000000000 --key PolarDBDiskUsage --start-time 2020-09-23T01:00Z --end-time 2020-09-23T01:01Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBNodePerformance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the node in the PolarDB cluster
parameters.name: db_node_id

parameters.help_en:
The granularity of the performance data. Valid values:

5

30

60

600

1800

3600

86400
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en: A special metric. Currently, only orca is supported
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The performance metrics to query. Separate multiple metrics with commas (,). For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141787.html.

You can query a maximum of five performance metrics.

If your cluster has Serverless enabled for fixed specifications, querying PolarDBCPU or PolarDBMemory alone ignores the Interval parameter and returns performance metrics per second. To get data at your specified Interval, query multiple metrics
parameters.help_zh:
查询的性能指标，多个值间用英文逗号（,）分隔，详细参数请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141787.html。


最多可传入5个查询的性能指标。
当您的集群开启固定规格集群的Serverless功能后，单独查询PolarDBCPU或PolarDBMemory指标时，会忽略Interval参数，固定按秒为单位返回性能指标列表。若您按指定的Interval参数返回数据，可以通过查询多个指标
parameters.name: key

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ` format. The time must be in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间。格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ`（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ` format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间。格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ`（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

DBNodeId.description_en: The ID of the node in the PolarDB cluster

EndTime.description_en: The end of the time range. The time is in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format. The time is in UTC
EndTime.description_zh: 查询结束时间。格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC时间）

PerformanceItem.description_en: The list of performance data for the cluster

MetricName.description_en: The name of the performance metric
MetricName.description_zh: 具体的性能指标度量名称

Timestamp.description_en: The data point in time. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds (ms)
Timestamp.description_zh: 监控指标的具体时间点，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒（ms）

Value.description_en: The value of the monitoring metric

StartTime.description_en: The beginning of the time range. The time is in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format. The time is in UTC
StartTime.description_zh: 查询开始时间。格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC时间）
